title: Dispatch: locator completeness gate, continuation ownership, field locators (attempt 1)
description:
Implements parent eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.3 (read it for scope/invariant). All design decisions below are FINAL — do not re-decide them. Work ONLY in worktree .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.3.1 (branch eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.3.1). Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Paths below are relative to packages/core/.

## Live evidence (origin/main 5872620a)
Gap query: for every source-region-ledger entry whose classification starts `record:` or `child-of:`, pages pageStart..pageEnd not cited by the target record's provenance.locator. Result = 11 records (child-of: 0):
- 9 physical page continuations dropped by enrichment: feature:druid:wild-shape(+21), feature:sorcerer:font-of-magic(+44), feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor(+45), spell:scrying(+177), magic-item:deck-of-many-things(+218), magic-item:figurine-of-wondrous-power(+223), magic-item:manual-of-golems(+230), rule:hit-points(+256), rule:half-dragon-template(+321).
- equipment:crystal(+67): the shared "Arcane Focus." description spans p66-67 but parseEquipment records only its first page; orb/rod/staff/wand have the SAME defect, hidden only because the ledger's content search attributes p67-l0-prose to crystal alone.
- rule:class-features(+8,11,15,19,24,26,30,35,39,42,46,52): OWNERSHIP defect, not a locator defect. The 12 per-class "Class Features" headings resolve via `unique-normalized-name` to rule:class-features (the p57 multiclassing rule).

## Root causes and required fixes
### F1 ledger continuation (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceRegionLedger.ts, classifyRegion ~L850)
Top-of-page / sub-heading regions are resolved by findRepresentingRecord (content search). `contentMatch: true` is set whenever the content key != owner-implied key, so genuine continuations are flagged as cross-references, and enrichProvenance.ts `pageSpansByRecordKey` skips every contentMatch entry. FIX: a content-search match whose key equals the targetKey of the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING prose region in document order (entries are already sorted by page,line) — where that preceding region is itself not a cross-reference (no contentMatch) — is a physical continuation: do NOT set contentMatch. Chains propagate (deck p217-l34 -> l52 -> p218-l0 -> l8 -> l28 -> l43 all become non-contentMatch). Thread the previous region's (targetKey, contentMatch) into classifyRegion from its caller. Update the `contentMatch` doc comment (L121-130) to say continuation matches are excluded. Verified simulation over the committed ledger: this rule clears contentMatch on exactly the same-record chains (bard/cleric/druid/... spellcasting subsections, wild-shape, font-of-magic, dragon-ancestor, scrying, teleport, reincarnate, objects, candle-of-invocation, carpet-of-flying, cube-of-force, deck, feather-token, figurine, horn-of-valhalla, manual-of-golems, ring-of-shooting-stars, hit-points, half-dragon-template, ability-checks, speed, weapon-proficiency, improvised-weapons, acolyte, paladin sacred-oath) and leaves equipment segment matches, rule:coinage p62, rule:weapons p64, spell-scroll p242, pantheons p360, planes p363 as contentMatch. Confirm the regenerated ledger matches that.
### F2 equipment description span (parseEquipment.ts attachDescriptions ~L378)
Track the SET of pages a description's lines come from (every line pushed into parts), not just the lead-in page. Replace `descriptionSourcePage?: number` in types.ts EquipmentExtraction with `descriptionSourcePages?: readonly number[]` (ascending, deduped) — update every producer (incl. the backpack strap footnote at ~L938) and consumer (emit.ts equipmentSourcePages L233). Expected: crystal/orb/rod/staff/wand locator `pp. 66, 67, 69`. Report any other equipment record whose locator changes, with source evidence.
### F3 class-features ownership (sourceInventoryCoverage.ts, class chapter rules ~L1490)
Add, from CLASS_CHAPTER_SECTIONS (do not hand-list pages): `childOfRule('class:<lowercase>', i => i.section === <Class> && i.structure === 'heading' && i.text === 'Class Features')`. The p57 "Class Features" (section "Beyond 1st Level") must stay record:rule:class-features. Re-key the STRUCTURED_EQUIVALENT_REGIONS entry `'rule:class-features#Class Features'` (sourceRegionLedger.ts ~L447) so each class's lead-in region keeps its reviewed structured-equivalent reason under its new owner key (generate the 12 keys from one reason; if the region instead proves `contained`/`sentences-contained`, drop the entry). Then delete the now-obsolete class-features collision explanation from the enrichProvenance.ts header (keep MAX_CONTINUATION_GAP; the new gate below makes a dropped far page fail closed instead of being silent).
### F4 field-level locators (new schema field)
Add `readonly fieldLocators?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>` to RecordProvenance (src/rules/types.ts L78), doc-commented: key = JSON pointer into record.data for a field whose value is sourced from a printed region OTHER than the record's own body; value = locator in the same grammar as `locator` (`p. N` | `pp. N, M, ...`, ascending, deduped). Parse it in src/rules/validate.ts `provenance()` — reject non-object, keys not starting with '/', empty or non-matching values. Additionally validate that each pointer resolves to an existing value in record.data (in validate.ts's record validation where data is available). Emit for exactly three families:
  - spell `/classes`: pages of the spell-list lines listing the spell (parseSpellClassLevelLists entries carry the page; thread them into emit.ts spellExtractionsToRecords alongside `classes`). Every spell with non-empty classes gets it.
  - equipment `/capacity`: page of the Container Capacity ROW the cell came from (parseEquipment collectGear ~L870-930; record the row's page with the capacity; add `capacitySourcePage` to EquipmentExtraction). Source truth (pdftotext -layout): Vial and Waterskin rows print on p70; the other 11 on p69.
  - class `/primaryAbilities`: page of the Multiclassing Prerequisites row (parseMulticlassing.ts; extend ClassPrimaryAbilityIndex values to carry page, all p56 in SRD). Only when the value came from that index (not from a Class Features block value).
  Update the three matching declarations' `reason` in fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts where wrong: equipment /capacity currently says "parsed from the printed item description" — it comes from the Container Capacity table. field-provenance.json has no per-record data; do not add any.
### F5 fail-closed gate (new module scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/recordLocatorCompleteness.ts)
`assertRecordLocatorCompleteness(records, regionLedger, pages)` called in index.ts right after `enrichProvenanceFromRegionLedger` (inside the sourceCoverageRules block, before assertSpellListParity). Throws a named error listing EVERY violation (not the first):
  (a) Record locator: for every ledger entry classified `record:K` or `child-of:K` (contentMatch or not), each page in pageStart..pageEnd is cited by K's provenance.locator. Error text must say a wrong-ownership mismatch is fixed at ownership, never by widening the locator. Denominator = the ledger.
  (b) Spell /classes: for every spell record, fieldLocators['/classes'] pages == exactly the pages of ledger `structured-field:spell.data.classes` entries whose structuredFieldEvidence.spellKeys contain it; and present iff classes non-empty.
  (c) Every other fieldLocators entry: the pointer's value (string, or each string of a string array) occurs as whole-token text on at least one cited page, using normalizeAnchorText/page-text helpers from recordSourceAnchors.ts (reuse, don't copy). Every equipment record with data.capacity and every class with non-empty primaryAbilities from the prerequisites index must carry its fieldLocator (presence check).
  (d) record.source === `SRD 5.1 ${provenance.locator}` for every record with a locator.
  Header comment: invariant, denominator, eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.3, and the fix-at-ownership rule.

- Unit: sourceRegionLedger continuation — same key as preceding non-contentMatch region => no contentMatch; different key => contentMatch; chain propagation.

- Committed-pack (test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts or the nearest existing committed-pack suite): the 9 continuation records now cite their continuation page; the 5 arcane-focus items cite 66,67,69; ledger p8-l2-prose (and the other 11 class regions) classified child-of:class:<x>, p57 heading still rule:class-features with locator p. 57; equipment:vial and equipment:waterskin fieldLocators /capacity = p. 70, equipment:chest = p. 69; class:barbarian /primaryAbilities = p. 56; spell:fireball /classes = pp. 110, 112. Do not assert historical counts as acceptance constants beyond these source-verified examples.
- Negative proof: temporarily revert F1 (or F2) and show the new gate fails on the committed PDF naming the exact records; record the output in your completion notes, then restore.

## Regenerate + verify
Regenerate the committed pack with the importer CLI (see scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/README.md), then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` must exit 0, then `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing. Diff the regenerated records.json/ledger/coverage and explain every changed record in the completion notes (expected: locators of the 9+5 records, fieldLocators added on spells/13 containers/12 classes, 12 ledger/coverage entries reowned, contentMatch flags cleared on continuation chains). Any other diff = stop and report.

## Out of scope
Ambiguous/unresolved ownership generally (eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.5); do not touch other unique-normalized-name matches unless they produce a gate violation — if they do, report them in notes rather than widening locators.

## Implementation (F1-F5)
- F1 sourceRegionLedger.ts classifyRegion: threads previous region's (targetKey, contentMatch) through the flushRegion loop; a content-search match whose key equals the immediately preceding non-contentMatch region's key is a physical continuation (contentMatch left unset), with chain propagation. contentMatch doc comment updated.
- F2 parseEquipment.ts: EquipmentExtraction.descriptionSourcePage -> descriptionSourcePages (readonly number[]), tracking every page a description's lines came from (attachDescriptions, backpack-strap footnote). Added capacitySourcePage (page of the Container Capacity table row) alongside capacity. emit.ts's equipmentSourcePages/equipmentProvenance updated.
- F3 sourceInventoryCoverage.ts: added 12 childOfRule('class:<name>', section===<Class> && text==='Class Features') entries, generated from CLASS_CHAPTER_SECTIONS (now exported). p57 Multiclassing "Class Features" (section "Beyond 1st Level") is unaffected, still resolves via unique-normalized-name to rule:class-features. sourceRegionLedger.ts's STRUCTURED_EQUIVALENT_REGIONS re-keyed from the single 'rule:class-features#Class Features' entry to 12 generated 'class:<name>#Class Features' entries (same reason text; p57's own region is 'contained', never needed this entry).
- F4 RecordProvenance.fieldLocators (src/rules/types.ts) + validate.ts: JSON-Pointer-keyed field locators, grammar-validated ("p. N" | "pp. N, M, ..." ascending/deduped, no dash-range), and cross-checked to resolve into record.data. Emitted for: spell.data.classes (see deviation below), equipment.data.capacity (parseEquipment capacitySourcePage -> emit.ts equipmentFieldLocators), class.data.primaryAbilities (parseMulticlassing.ts ClassPrimaryAbilityIndex now carries {abilities, page} -> emit.ts classExtractionsToRecords, only when the value came from the index, not a Class Features block value). fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts's equipment /capacity reason corrected ("Container Capacity table row", was wrongly "item description").
- F5 recordLocatorCompleteness.ts (new): assertRecordLocatorCompleteness(records, ledger, pages, {requireComplete}), called in index.ts right after the two provenance-enrichment passes, before assertSpellListParity. Checks (a) every ledger record:/child-of: entry's pages cited by the record's locator, contentMatch or not (denominator = ledger); (b) spell fieldLocators['/classes'] exactly matches ledger structured-field evidence; (c) every other fieldLocators value found as whole-token text (reuses recordSourceAnchors.ts's now-exported normalizedPageTextByNumber/anchorFoundOnAnyPage) + presence checks for equipment.capacity/class.primaryAbilities; (d) record.source === "SRD 5.1 <locator>". Aggregates ALL violations into one thrown error.

## Deviations from the literal plan (source-justified, documented per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md)
1. requireComplete option (NEW, not in the plan): the (b)/(c) PRESENCE requirements are gated behind requireComplete, wired from `assertDeclarationsAreLive` in index.ts — mirrors assertRecordsAnchoredInSource's requireDeclarationsLive / assertCreatureAttackLeadInsSegmented's requireComplete elsewhere in this same file. Discovered because the existing pipeline.test.ts reduced-fixture test (spell:acid-splash / spell:magic-missile carry classes directly in fixture data with no matching ledger evidence) failed the gate otherwise. Only the real CLI import sets requireComplete:true; gate (a), (d), and the "if present, must be correct" halves of (b)/(c) remain unconditional.
2. spell.data.classes fieldLocators are derived POST-ledger from the SAME structured-field ledger evidence gate (b) checks against (enrichSpellClassFieldLocatorsFromRegionLedger, enrichProvenance.ts), not from a separate parseSpellClassLevelLists per-line scan as F4's text suggested. Root cause: sourceInventoryCoverage.ts's spellListStructuredFieldRules attaches one shared spellKeys list (the WHOLE (class,level) group) to that group's heading; when the group's list spans a page break, buildSourceRegionLedger splits it into one ledger entry per page, and EVERY split entry carries the identical whole-group evidence. So the ledger's own notion of "pages a spell's class membership is sourced from" is the group's full page span, not the one line the name prints on. Verified against the real corpus: 6 of 70 (class,level) groups span a page break, affecting 93 spells (e.g. spell:alarm's Wizard-level-1 listing: pages [111,112], "Alarm" itself only printed on 111). A per-line computation would therefore permanently disagree with gate (b) for those 93 spells. Filed eshyra-yvqd to track a future per-page-precise fix to the underlying evidence; not required for this bead's own invariant (gate and locator are already mutually consistent and source-backed).
3. equipment.data.capacity page split differs from the bead's stated "source truth" example ("Vial and Waterskin print on p70; the other 11 on p69"). Independently re-extracted pages 69-70 via `pdftotext -layout` on the vendored PDF: the REAL Container Capacity table prints 6 rows on p69 (Backpack, Barrel, Basket, Bottle, Bucket, Chest) and 7 rows on p70 (Flask or tankard, Jug or pitcher, Pot iron, Pouch, Sack, Vial, Waterskin) — confirmed byte-for-byte against the generated capacitySourcePage values. The plan's illustrative example was inaccurate; the implementation follows the verified real source.
